articles.title: Direct-To-Consumer Drug Models Risk Inflating Employer Health Plan Costs
articles.summary: Direct-to-consumer (DTC) drug pricing models often bypass traditional pharmacy benefit management structures, potentially shifting costs and creating financial blind spots for self-funded employers. Plan sponsors must scrutinize how DTC arrangements interact with overall plan design, utilization management, and total cost of care.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Thu, 08 Oct 2026 20:46:05 GMT

articles.title: PBMs Advocate for Flexible Drug Prior Authorization Rules
articles.summary: Pharmacy benefit managers are pushing for increased flexibility in drug prior authorization regulations to better manage specialty drug utilization and control plan costs. For self-funded employers, shifting prior authorization standards directly impact administrative workflows and pharmacy benefit design. This advocacy highlights ongoing efforts by the PBM industry to shape utilization management rules amid mounting regulatory scrutiny.

articles.title: GLP-1 Pharmacy Benefit Strategies Flatten Costs and Improve Patient Persistence
articles.summary: Recent pharmacy practice data indicates that structured GLP-1 benefit designs can successfully flatten cost curves while simultaneously improving long-term medication persistence. For self-funded employers grappling with surging obesity drug expenditures, these findings offer actionable insights into more effective plan management and utilization controls. This approach highlights how targeted pharmacy benefit strategies can balance financial sustainability with positive clinical outcomes in commercial populations.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmacy Practice News; Thu, 08 Oct 2026 14:37:45 GMT

articles.title: CVS Caremark Emphasizes Transparency in Pharmacy Benefits Strategy
articles.summary: CVS Caremark published a corporate perspective focusing on the importance of transparency within pharmacy benefits management. For self-funded employers, this reflects ongoing industry pressure from regulatory bodies and competitors to adopt clearer pricing models, such as pass-through structures and net cost accounting.
articles.source_line: Source: CVS Health; Thu, 08 Oct 2026 15:26:07 GMT

articles.title: Alvotech and LOTTE Biologics Partner for US Biosimilar Manufacturing
articles.summary: Alvotech and LOTTE Biologics have entered into an agreement to manufacture biosimilars in the United States. This supply chain development supports the broader availability and market uptake of lower-cost biosimilar alternatives, which is a critical cost-management strategy for self-funded employers seeking to mitigate specialty drug spending through PBM formulary optimization.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Store News; Thu, 08 Oct 2026 14:33:12 GMT

articles.title: Cost Comparison of Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drugs Versus Traditional Pharmacies
articles.summary: This article examines pricing differences between Mark Cuban's Cost Plus Drug Company and traditional corporate-owned pharmacies. For self-funded employers and PBMs, understanding these direct-to-consumer cash-pay models is crucial as they increasingly compete with traditional insurance benefit designs for generic and specialty drugs.
